mapper.select: /* InterfaceMapper.existsInterface 인터페이스ID가 등록되어 있는지 판별 */ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_INFC_M WHERE INFC_ID = #{infcId})
mapper.update: /* InterfaceMapper.updateInterface 인터페이스를 수정 */ UPDATE TB_INFC_M SET INFC_NM = #{item.infcNm}, HTTP_METH_NM = #{item.httpMethNm}, URL = #{item.url}, BODY_LOG_YN = #{item.bodyLogYn}, MASK_FLD_CONT = NULLIF(#{item.maskFldCont}, ''), USE_YN = #{item.useYn}, RMK = NULLIF(#{item.rmk}, ''), FINA_REGR_ID = #{usrId}, FINA_REG_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE INFC_ID = #{item.infcId}
